title: Split-KV: Efficient Context Parallelism for Training Diffusion Drafters
abstract: arXiv:2611.05926v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by denoising multiple draft tokens in parallel. Their training uses anchor sampling to construct compact draft queries and performs cross-attention with a block-sparse mask over a much longer context. We empirically show that acceptance length remains stable as context scales with a fixed query budget, while increasing the query budget yields diminishing quality gains, jointly establishing a practical regime with queries far shorter than the context. No existing context parallelism (CP) method jointly exploits this query--context asymmetry and meets the nonlinear, sample-dependent load-balancing requirement created by anchor sampling. We present Split-KV, an exact CP method that keeps key/value shards local and limits per-layer attention communication to query-sized tensors, making this communication independent of context length. translated_title: Split-KV：面向扩散起草器训练的高效上下文并行方法
translated_abstract: 扩散起草器通过并行去噪多个草稿词元来加速投机解码。其训练采用锚点采样构建紧凑的草稿查询，并通过块稀疏掩码在长得多的上下文上执行交叉注意力。我们通过实验证明：在固定查询预算下，接受长度随上下文规模扩大而保持稳定；而增加查询预算所带来的质量收益递减——这两点共同确立了一种查询远短于上下文的实用工作模式。然而，现有的上下文并行方法均无法同时利用这种查询-上下文不对称性，也无法满足锚点采样所导致的非线性、样本依赖的负载均衡需求。我们提出了Split-KV，这是一种精确的上下文并行方法，它将键/值分片保留在本地，并将每层的注意力通信限制为查询大小的张量，从而使通信量与上下文长度无关。其全局查询视图进一步支持了代价感知的最长…（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Split-KV，一种精确的上下文并行方法，通过在本地保留键/值分片并将注意力通信限制为查询大小的张量，使通信量与上下文长度无关，从而高效训练扩散起草器。
en_tdlr: Split-KV is an exact context parallelism method for training diffusion drafters that keeps key/value shards local and limits per-layer attention communication to query-sized tensors, making communication independent of context length.
